QuestInfo.name: Into the World
QuestInfo.0: You can't take this training anymore! Maybe you're not ready to fight the fearsome #o0210100#s yet, but who cares? #bJust go outside already#k!
QuestInfo.1: Enough training! Time to go into the world outside. If you can't handle the #o0210100#s, you can always run away. So for now, give those #r#o0210100#s#k your best shot. #o0210100##r #a240451##k
QuestInfo.2: The #o0210100#s were Lv. 50 before you were cursed. It hasn't been THAT long since you fought the Black Mage, could it?

0.0: These dummies just won't be enough to get my full strength back. There's no choice. I'm no match for the\r\n#r#o0210100#s#k, so I'll just have to run past them as fast as\r\nI can. Besides, it's not like any of my people are awake to see their sovereign in such a state...

yes.0: I can do this! It wouldn't hurt to take a few shots at the\r\n#o0210100#s, anyway. It'll be good practice.

no.0: No. I'm still the ruler of the Elves! I can't run from #o0210100#s,\r\ncan I? Maybe I should train just a while longer.

1.0: This can't be... #rSince when are #o0210100#s this weak?#k Okay, so I can't take them down as easily as I used to, but I shouldn't be able to take them on AT ALL in my current state. This can't be right...

default.0: Fine, if that's the case, why not just fight them? Elluel is right here if I need to fall back. I might as well warm up against these new, super-weak #r#o0210100#s#k.
